title: Pilot tolerance chain + P006 service-tool envelope
status: PARTIAL / TOLERANCE STUDY DEFINED / TOOL FEATURE OPEN
purpose: Close the remaining production-clearance and service-access risk created by the compact ID12.00 pilot without changing the validated C2R1 flange architecture.

tolerance_candidate.basis: Use standard, readily inspectable unilateral ISO-286 zones on two clearance-envelope diameters; these surfaces are not a locating fit.
tolerance_candidate.P003_pilot_OD: Ø14.10 g6 -> approximately 14.083...14.094 mm in the 10-18 mm ISO 286 size band
interpretation: The minimum head/pilot radial clearance remains 0.250 mm because H9 cannot go below 12.000 and h9 cannot go above 11.500.
Even at the study worst-case pilot OD/ID limits, the pilot radial wall remains about 1.020 mm.
This is a manufacturability/clearance proposal, not a functional fit pair; drawing wording must not imply that the ID12/head interface locates the assembly.

service_tool_envelope.finding: A conventional external socket or wrench around the Ø11.5 P006 head is incompatible with the Ø12 minimum pilot opening; the available radial annulus is too small for a useful socket wall.
service_tool_envelope.selected_architecture: Hollow axial face-drive tool passing through the pilot and engaging dedicated face-drive features on P006.
service_tool_envelope.P006_feature_rule: Use two diametrically opposed face-drive seats/dogs in the annular head face outside the Ø6 through bore. Exact dog/slot width, depth, edge ligaments and drive radius shall be sized from the released P006 assembly/removal torque, not guessed.
service_tool_envelope.why_not_external_hex: The compact pilot leaves only 0.25 mm nominal radial head clearance, so a normal socket geometry would either not pass the pilot or would have impractically thin walls.
remaining_inputs: released P006 seating/removal torque or measurable assembly method that prevents PEEK crushing
minimum face-drive feature strength and inspection criterion

decision: Keep C2R1 pilot ID12.00 as active study. Carry H9/h9 as the preferred tolerance study. Carry a hollow face-drive service tool as the preferred architecture. Do not mark T03 PASS until the P006 drive feature and service torque/assembly method are released.
